items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Pelley see. He's there too. I see him there about six or seven years.

ctx.x: So who was the saxophone player? Well, uh... With T-Boy and him. With T-Boy and you. Who was the saxophone player? Oh, I see. Pelley see. He's there too. I see him there about six or seven years.
And ask him if you ever worked with the Young Morgan Band.
